summary: TriCo Bancshares filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026, disclosing that its board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.36 per share on the common stock on August 20, 2026. The dividend is payable September 25, 2026, to holders of record September 11, 2026, and marks the 148th consecutive quarterly cash dividend. No advisor or board recommendation was named. The action is a routine capital return funded from bank operations; the ex-dividend date and any future special dividend or buyback commentary are the items to watch.
